nodes.name: sessionHandlers.ts
nodes.summary: Handlers for session-lifecycle Rust wire events — turn completion, errors, warnings, goal loops, context usage, stream-retry status, and session eviction — that settle the session's running/streaming state machine.

nodes.name: settleTerminalRuntime
nodes.summary: Resets streaming state, clears stream-retry status, and notifies the status callback when a turn reaches a terminal outcome (completed/failed/cancelled).

nodes.name: handleContextUsage
nodes.summary: Forwards contextUsage or legacy contextTokens payloads from an agent:context_usage event to the session's context-usage callback.

nodes.name: handleComplete
nodes.summary: Handles agent:complete by settling terminal runtime state and finalizing the session's completion callback.

nodes.name: handleTurnCompleted
nodes.summary: Handles agent:turn_completed by settling terminal runtime state for the finished turn.

nodes.name: handleTurnSummary
nodes.summary: Records a turn-summary event for the session.

nodes.name: handleError
nodes.summary: Handles agent:error by settling terminal runtime state and surfacing the error to the session's error callback.

nodes.name: handleWarning
nodes.summary: Logs an agent:warning event.

nodes.name: handleGoalLoop
nodes.summary: Logs detection of an agent goal loop reported by Rust.

nodes.name: handleStreamRetry
nodes.summary: Handles agent:stream_retry by updating the stream-retry status atom so the UI can show a reconnecting indicator.

nodes.name: handleStreamErrorExhausted
nodes.summary: Handles agent:stream_error_exhausted by clearing retry status and surfacing a terminal stream error once reconnection attempts are exhausted.

nodes.name: handleSessionEvicted
nodes.summary: Handles agent:session_evicted by resetting streaming state and clearing retry status when the session's Rust-side connection is evicted.

nodes.name: clearStreamRetryStatus
nodes.summary: Clears the stream-retry status atom entry for a session.

nodes.name: shellHandlers.ts
nodes.summary: Handlers for shell/exec Rust wire events — exec output buffering and shell process lifecycle (started/backgrounded/exited) plus subagent job status updates.

nodes.name: handleExecOutput
nodes.summary: Buffers streaming exec output from a running shell tool for the session, capped at MAX_EXEC_BUFFER.

nodes.name: handleShellProcessStarted
nodes.summary: Handles agent:shell_process_started by recording the new shell process in the shell-process atom.

nodes.name: handleShellProcessBackgrounded
nodes.summary: Handles agent:shell_process_backgrounded by marking a shell process as running in the background.

nodes.name: handleShellProcessExited
nodes.summary: Handles agent:shell_process_exited by recording the shell process's exit code and final output.

nodes.name: handleSubagentJobChanged
nodes.summary: Handles agent:subagent_job_changed by updating the subagent job atom with the job's latest status.

nodes.name: streamHandlers.ts
nodes.summary: Handlers for live streaming deltas (message/thinking/tool-call) and the terminal agent:streaming_complete event from Rust's StreamingBuffer.

nodes.name: appendLiveStreamDelta
nodes.summary: Appends an incoming text delta onto the live message/thinking stream refs and returns the accumulated content.

nodes.name: handleMessageDelta
nodes.summary: Handles agent:message_delta by appending the delta to the assistant stream ref and updating streaming-info state.

nodes.name: handleThinkingDelta
nodes.summary: Handles agent:thinking_delta by appending the delta to the thinking stream ref and updating streaming-info state.

nodes.name: handleToolCallDelta
nodes.summary: Handles agent:tool_call_delta by buffering partial tool-call arguments per tool_call_id until the full call is emitted.

nodes.name: handleStreamingComplete
nodes.summary: Handles agent:streaming_complete by clearing message/thinking stream refs and finalizing the buffered streaming turn from Rust's StreamingBuffer.

nodes.name: streamHelpers.ts
nodes.summary: Shared per-session streaming state utilities — turn/stop tracking, tool-call id/name extraction, and stream-ref clearing/updating — used across the rustAgent event handler modules.

nodes.name: noteSessionStreamingTurn
nodes.summary: Records the turn id currently streaming for a session.

nodes.name: getActiveSessionStreamingTurn
nodes.summary: Returns the turn id currently streaming for a session, if any.

nodes.name: markSessionStreamingStopped
nodes.summary: Marks a session's active streaming turn as user-stopped so late-arriving deltas are ignored.

nodes.name: clearSessionStreamingStopped
nodes.summary: Clears the stopped marker for a session's streaming turn.

nodes.name: isSessionStreamingStopped
nodes.summary: Checks whether a session's given turn has been marked as stopped by the user.

nodes.name: resetAllStreamingState
nodes.summary: Resets all per-session streaming refs and stopped/turn tracking state on a handler context.

nodes.name: getToolCallId
nodes.summary: Extracts the tool_call_id from an agent WS event.

nodes.name: getToolName
nodes.summary: Extracts the tool name from an agent WS event.

nodes.name: getEventSessionId
nodes.summary: Extracts the session id from an agent WS event.

nodes.name: clearStreamingInfo
nodes.summary: Clears the context's isStreaming/isThinking streaming-info state.

nodes.name: clearMessageStreamRefs
nodes.summary: Resets the assistant message stream ref's accumulated content and id.

nodes.name: clearThinkingStreamRefs
nodes.summary: Resets the thinking stream ref's accumulated content and id.

nodes.name: updateStreamingInfo
nodes.summary: Updates the context's streaming-info state (isStreaming/isThinking/content) for UI consumption.

nodes.name: subagentHandlers.ts
nodes.summary: Legacy coding-session bridge handler retained for the OS Agent variant; routes a handful of subagent WS event types to update the parent tool_call's task args, since Rust now owns most of the subagent data path.
nodes.languageNotes: Header comment documents that five of the six original subagent_* handlers were retired in favor of Rust-side tracking; only the coding-session bridge remains.

nodes.name: handleCodingSessionEvent
nodes.summary: Routes a spawned coding-session's WS events (todos, complete, error) back onto the parent tool_call for the OS Agent's legacy coding-session bridge.

nodes.name: toolHandlers.ts
nodes.summary: Handlers for tool_call, tool_result, and interaction-finalized events, including canvas-inline dispatch and auto mode-switch acceptance; re-exports the shell process handlers from shellHandlers.ts as its public surface.

nodes.name: isAutoModeSwitchAccept
nodes.summary: Checks whether a finalized suggest_mode_switch interaction represents an auto-accepted timeout mode switch.

nodes.name: handleToolCall
nodes.summary: Handles agent:tool_call by resetting stream buffers, dispatching a DOM tool-call event, and triggering canvas-inline dispatch for render_inline_canvas calls.

nodes.name: handleToolResult
nodes.summary: Handles agent:tool_result by clearing MCP progress and, for the OS Agent coding-session bridge, detecting and tracking spawned subagent sessions from the result content.

nodes.name: dispatchCanvasInlineEventFromArgs
nodes.summary: Dispatches a canvas-inline-event using the full render_inline_canvas args (not the truncated tool_result string) so large HTML payloads are not corrupted.

nodes.name: handleInteractionFinalized
nodes.summary: Handles agent:interaction_finalized by merging the authoritative result into the EventStore and auto-switching modes when a suggest_mode_switch was accepted via timeout.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared TypeScript types and constants (EventHandlerContext, RustAgentFeatures, buffer/length limits) consumed by every rustAgent event handler module.
